era: 明代航海时代（1371年云南昆阳穆斯林家庭（马姓，父马哈只有朝觐之称）—1381年明军平云南，十岁左右被掳入燕王府为宦官—靖难之役随军立功（郑村坝之战，赐姓郑）—1405年首下西洋（27800人、两百余船）—1407年旧港之战擒陈祖义、设旧港宣慰司—1409年立《布施锡兰山佛寺碑》三体碑—1411年锡兰山之战擒亚烈苦奈儿—1417年苏禄东王亲朝、病葬德州—1431年长乐立《天妃灵应之记》碑、第七次出航—1433年卒于归途（一说卒于古里）：昆阳—北平—南京—占城—满剌加—古里—忽鲁谟斯—天方—归途）
school: 明代国家航海外交体系的执行者与总设计师 + 郑和舰队（宝船船队）统帅（钦差正使总兵太监）+ 印度洋朝贡秩序的现场建筑师 + 大规模航海建制的组织者（牵星术、针路簿、分船队编成）
style_name: 本名马和，小字三保；赐姓郑，人称三宝太监/三保太监；出使时正式身份为'钦差正使总兵太监'
courtesy_name: 本姓马（Ma He），永乐二年（1404）以靖难功赐姓郑；伊斯兰教名为哈儿只·马哈只之子；佛教法名福善（人称三宝太监或与'三宝佛'信仰有关）
pseudonym: 无笔名；立碑著文用本官衔与姓名（长乐《天妃灵应之记》碑署'正使太监郑和、王景弘'）；与陶行知以改名做认识论声明恰成对照——郑和的身份声明由皇帝赐姓完成，本人终身沿用
historical_significance: 郑和（1371-1433），云南昆阳人，明代宦官、航海家、外交家，七次统率宝船船队下西洋（1405-1433），每一次出航27000人上下、船两百余艘，航迹遍及东南亚、南亚、波斯湾、阿拉伯半岛与东非三十余国。他不是发现者（航路上处处有前人针路），而是把航海变成国家制度的组织者：五大部分建制、牵星术与针路簿、满剌加官厂枢纽、分船队协议式集结——在哥伦布之前近一个世纪，人类第一次让万吨级国家力量在两大洋之间按季风节律往返。他的外交原则'耀兵异域而不侵占'提供了炮舰时代之前最后的秩序想象：以仪式与公共品而非领土与殖民地组织国际关系。1433年他死于归途，远航随之终结，档案散佚——他留下的最大遗产恰是那个反证：没有制度化的知识传承与可持续的经济逻辑，再高的组织成就也敌不过一道停罢诏书。
unique_thinking: 郑和的独特贡献是把'远洋'从冒险改写为建制，从航行改写为秩序工程：其一，国家队整建制投送——五大部分齐备、人数恒定、七次可重复出航，规模本身是外交语言；其二，牵星过洋——牵星术、罗盘、航海图三系统互校，把老船长的默会知识写成三层参数的显性针路簿；其三，耀兵而不征——拥有压倒性武力而克制使用，比例响应三级递进，胜利的处置方式成为向各国广播的规则；其四，宝船货架——移动的多品类市场，品类组合、结算切换、官方定价与市场议价并行；其五，多语情报网——通事建制、三部亲历文献、节点情报与'下航校上航'的组织学习循环；其六，分船队协同——无实时通信条件下以共享参数（季风、针路、更数）达成协议式集结，hub-and-spoke 的古典原型；其七，身份跨界杠杆——穆斯林宦官的三重边缘身份转化为单线忠诚、跨文明接口与绕开官僚轨道的执行优势；其八，仪式秩序替代领土秩序——名实交换、仪式即治理、准入分层，不驻一兵而维持万邦差序；其九，节律窗口——全部日程长在印度洋季风上，等待是计划内成本，窗口本身是战略资源；其十，档案断代审计——他的档案遭遇（焚毁、贬语、散佚）反向演示了'从沉默中读史'：沉默检测、多源互校、碑刻时间锚、叙事利益分析。十项模式合观：郑和把战略、技术、外交、贸易、情报、组织、身份、秩序、时机与史学十种能力压进同一支船队，其中任何一项单独看都不是首创——首创的是把它们压成一个可重复运转的整体，并在制度崩溃之后，把自己的失败也变成一个可供后人审计的方法论样本。

cross_references.relation_type: 战略同构：庙算先胜与整建制投送；知彼知己与多语情报网
cross_references.description_zh: 郑和是孙武原则在远洋尺度上的执行者：'先胜而后战'在郑和这里展开为'先建制而后出航'——五大部分的整建制核验是庙算的工程化，'胜于庙堂'变成'胜于船坞与官厂'。孙武'知彼知己'（M-SW-003）在郑和这里升级为跨语言的情报建制：通事、亲历文献与节点情报把'知彼'从战前侦查扩展为28年不间断的组织学习。分野在目的：孙武的庙算服务于会战，郑和的庙算服务于'不必会战'——耀兵而不征正是'不战而屈人之兵'的远洋版：三次战斗全部由对方先动手触发，胜利的处置方式本身就是下一轮威慑。对照链：M-MV-001（整建制投送）× M-SW-001（庙算先胜）、M-MV-005（多语情报网）× M-SW-003（知彼知己）。

cross_references.description_zh: 利德尔·哈特主张间接路线与限战节制（M-LH-001/M-LH-004）：最高战略是让武力停在'不必使用'的位置，胜利以最小战斗达成。郑和在15世纪即以建制实践了同一原则：七次出航28年仅三战，三战皆由对方越线触发；锡兰山之战以二千精锐乘虚取城而非与五万大军对攻——'间接'得近乎教科书。处置学的对照尤其深刻：利德尔·哈特警示'胜利的处置不当会种下一场战争'（凡尔赛的教训），郑和的赦免放归锡兰国王、只诛首恶的处理正是'以处置播规则'的正面样本。分野在终局：郑和的克制服务于朝贡秩序的维持（仪式性目标），利德尔·哈特的克制服务于均势的保存（现实政治目标）。对照链：M-MV-003（耀兵不征）× M-LH-004（克敌于未战-限战节制）。

cross_references.description_zh: 司马迁立'实录精神'（M-SMQ-321）：网罗天下放失旧闻，原始察终，见盛观衰——档案在，则如实录之。郑和案例提供了这条原则的反向运用（M-MV-010）：当实录被系统性销毁（刘大夏焚档公案）、正史被党争叙事污染（《明史》对宦官的贬语），史家必须从'缺席'本身读出证据——应有记录的沉默、亲历文献与官方叙事的分歧点、碑刻实物的时间锚、每个叙事版本背后的利益方。司马迁相信档案会说话，郑和案例证明档案的沉默同样说话。两案合读构成史料批判的完整回路：有档者实录之，无档者审其断代之痕。对照链：M-MV-010（档案断代审计）× M-SMQ-321（实录精神）。

caveats: 宝船尺度史料高度存疑：《明史》'长四十四丈'说与静海寺残碑漫漶文字引发百年争议，造船史学界对宝船实际尺寸与'万吨'说均有保留——引用时须标注争议，不可当定论
下西洋动机无定论：寻建文帝说（《明史》采）、耀兵异域说、朝贡贸易说、遏制帖木儿说并存，《明史·郑和传》自述其为'成祖疑惠帝亡海外，欲踪迹之'——动机本身是叙事政治的产物
旧港之战的性质存在史料分歧：《明实录》记陈祖义'诈降潜谋邀劫'，马欢《瀛涯胜览》仅记其'凶横'而无劫船之谋；现代研究（雪珥等）质疑'诈降'叙事为主动出击寻找师出有名的建构——不可单采官方叙事

modes.definition_zh: 郑和的元命题：远洋行动不从'发现'出发而从'建制'出发——把航海变成一支可重复出航的国家机器。方法论签名有四：其一，建制备货——每次出航五大部分齐备（指挥、航海、外交贸易、后勤保障、军事护航），人数恒在27000上下，约五个卫的兵力按军事组织编成，不是冒险家凑的船而是国家出航的整建制单元；其二，可重复性判据——1405-1433年七次出航、间隔可计算、路线可复用，'下西洋'从一次壮举变成一种制度；其三，规模即信号——宝船船队的体量本身就是外交语言，未战而先'庙算'到位；其四，后勤先于雄心——船队载金银、瓷器、丝绸、茶叶、农具，粮淡水修船随队，行动半径由补给链而不是由勇气决定。这一模式与孙武'庙算先胜'同构（先胜后战，胜于庙堂），但把它从会战前推到整个远洋行动的生命周期。
modes.definition_en: Zheng He's master proposition: blue-water action begins not from 'discovery' but from 'institution' — voyaging becomes a state machine capable of repeated sorties. Four signatures define the mode. First, institutional provisioning: every voyage carries five complete branches (command, navigation, diplomacy-trade, logistics, military escort), a standing force of some 27,000 organized as roughly five wei guards on military lines — not adventurers' ships but a whole-system state unit. Second, repeatability as the criterion: seven voyages across 1405-1433, computable intervals, reusable routes — 'sailing the Western Ocean' turns from a feat into a system. Third, scale as signal: the sheer size of the treasure fleet is itself diplomatic language, the battle won in the council before any wave. Fourth, logistics before ambition: bullion, porcelain, silk, tea, farm tools aboard; grain, water and shipwrights in train — the radius of action is set by the supply chain, not by courage. Isomorphic with Sunzi's 'victory first, battle after' (M-SW-001), but extended from the eve of battle to the whole life-cycle of an expedition.
modes.source_chapter: 《明史·郑和传》；《明成祖实录》永乐三年至五年条；马欢《瀛涯胜览》（船队组织与贸易品目）
process_zh: 审计建制完备性：出航前列五大部分（指挥/航海/外交贸易/后勤/护航）逐项核验，缺一项即延期而非带病出航
把一次性壮举改写为制度：固定出航节奏、可复用路线、标准化的装备与人员编成清单
把规模当语言用：在'威慑'与'炫耀'之间选择，投送体量须服务于谈判目标而非帝王虚荣
以补给链定行动半径：先画后勤再画航线，凡超出补给能力的雄心一律削减
process_en: Audit institutional completeness: before any major operation verify the five branches (command / navigation / diplomacy-trade / logistics / escort); if one is missing, postpone rather than sail crippled.
Convert one-off feats into institutions: fixed cadence, reusable routes, standardized equipment and rosters.
Use scale as language: choose between 'deterrence' and 'ostentation' — tonnage must serve the negotiation objective, not imperial vanity.
Let the supply chain set the radius: draw logistics before routes; any ambition beyond supply capacity is cut.
representative_cases_zh: 第一次下西洋（1405）：27800人、两百余艘船，五大部分齐备——郑和船队不是探险队而是'浮动的都城'；同一世纪哥伦布87人、达伽马170人的船队面对的是另一种量级的组织物
七次出航的时间结构：1405-1433年间出航间隔与路线大体可预测，古里（卡利卡特）成为每次必到的'中转母港'——重复出航使路线知识沉淀为国家的可遗传资产
反面警示：宣德八年（1433）后远航骤停，宝船档案散佚（相传兵部尚书刘大夏藏匿/焚毁）——没有制度化的知识传承，最高水平的建制可以在一代人之内清零；'国家队'若不把能力写进制度而只写在档案里，档案一毁能力即亡
representative_cases_en: The first voyage (1405): 27,800 men, over two hundred ships, five complete branches — not an expedition but a 'floating capital'; Columbus's 87 and da Gama's 170 men in the same century faced an organization of another order of magnitude.

The temporal structure of seven voyages: predictable intervals and routes across 1405-1433, with Calicut as the recurring 'hub port' — repeated sailing sedimented route knowledge into a heritable national asset.

Cautionary counterexample: after 1433 the voyages stopped outright and the shipyard archives scattered (Liu Daxiao famously hid or burned them) — without institutionalized knowledge transfer, the most advanced capability can be zeroed within one generation; if the 'national team' keeps capability only in files, burning files burns capability.
modern_applications_zh: 重大行动筹备审计：跨部门大项目按五大部分核验建制，指挥/技术/对外/后勤/安保缺项即延期
企业出海战略：不做一次性的'试试看'，按可重复节奏建航线、建据点、建标准——把首航的经验写进制度而不是写进个人记忆
谈判中的规模信号：投入体量与谈判目标对齐，避免'为面子加杠杆'式的过度投送
供应链先行原则：海外拓展先落后勤与补给节点，再谈扩张半径
modern_applications_en: Major-operations audit: verify the five branches before any cross-department undertaking; postpone on any missing branch.
Corporate go-abroad strategy: no one-off experiments — build routes, footholds and standards on a repeatable cadence; write first-voyage lessons into institutions, not into personal memory.
Scale as a signal in negotiation: align investment magnitude with the negotiation objective; avoid leveraged over-projection for face.
Supply chain first: place logistics nodes before expansion radii.

modes.key_quote_en: To project power abroad, first build the institution at home; won in the council hall, won upon the waves.

modes.definition_zh: 郑和的航海技术命题：在无近代通讯与定位设备的条件下，用'多重方法交叉验证'逼近真值。方法论签名有四：其一，牵星术——以牵星板测星体高度定纬度，把天文定位与罗盘航向结合，'天文定位×罗盘×航海图'三系统互校；其二，针路簿知识管理——《郑和航海图》以针路（罗盘方位）、更数（航程时间）、牵星数据三层参数记录航线，把老船长的默会知识写成可传递的显性文件；其三，对景定位——以山形、水势、物标交叉核对推算船位，属于'推算与观测互相审计'的原始形式；其四，季风节律——候风开洋，利用印度洋季风体系安排往返窗口，把自然节律变成日程表的一部分。这是15世纪的'多源数据融合'：任何单一传感器都不可靠，可靠性来自交叉验证的结构。
modes.definition_en: Zheng He's navigational proposition: with no modern communications or positioning, approach truth via 'cross-validation of multiple methods.' Four signatures. First, star-guiding (牵星术): boards measure stellar altitudes for latitude, fused with compass headings — celestial fix, compass and charts as three mutually auditing systems. Second, the needle-route books as knowledge management: the Zheng He charts record routes in three parameter layers (compass bearing, time-in-watches distance, star data), converting tacit helmsmen's craft into explicit, transferable documents. Third, terrain-based fixing: coastlines, currents and landmarks cross-check dead-reckoned positions — a primitive form of 'estimation audited by observation.' Fourth, monsoon rhythm: departures timed to the Indian Ocean monsoon system, turning natural periodicity into the schedule itself. This is fifteenth-century multi-source fusion: no single sensor is trusted; reliability lives in the cross-validation structure.
modes.source_chapter: 《郑和航海图》（茅元仪《武备志》卷二百四十收录）；《顺风相送》系统针路簿；马欢《瀛涯胜览》、费信《星槎胜览》
process_zh: 为关键过程建立至少两套独立测量：任何单一来源（传感器/报告/直觉）不作为唯一决策依据
把默会知识写成三层参数的显性文件（方向/距离/校准点），使个人技艺可传递、可审计
定期用'对景'式外部观测审计推算结果：推算与观测不一致时停止前进先修正
把环境节律编入日程：候风而行胜于逆风硬闯，节奏本身是方法的一部分
process_en: Establish at least two independent measurements for any critical process; no single source (sensor, report, intuition) is ever the sole basis for a decision.
Write tacit knowledge into explicit documents with layered parameters (direction / distance / calibration points), making craft transferable and auditable.
Audit dead-reckoning with 'sight-of-land' style external observations; when estimate and observation disagree, stop and correct before proceeding.
Encode environmental rhythm into the schedule: sail with the monsoon rather than against it — pacing is part of the method.
representative_cases_zh: 《郑和航海图》自南京至忽鲁谟斯全程以针路、更数、牵星数据三层标注，茅元仪1621年收入《武备志》得以传世——一份'航海参数表'比宝船活得更久
横渡印度洋：从苏门答腊至锡兰至古里的大洋直航段全靠牵星术定位，是中国航海史上第一次有系统记录的大洋跨越
反面警示：郑和之后的明清海图与针路簿渐次散佚，'牵星过洋'的能力失传近三百年，直到后人从《武备志》里考古——显性化文件若无人维护传承，能力随文件一起死去
representative_cases_en: The Zheng He charts annotate the whole Nanjing-to-Hormuz passage in three layers (compass bearing, watch-count distance, star data); Mao Yuanyi's 1621 Wubei Zhi preserved them — a 'parameter table' outlived the treasure ships.
The Indian Ocean crossings: open-sea legs from Sumatra via Ceylon to Calicut navigated by star-guiding — the first systematically documented ocean crossing in Chinese maritime history.

Cautionary counterexample: after Zheng He, Ming-Qing charts and needle-route books scattered, and the star-guiding skill was lost for nearly three centuries until archaeologized from the Wubei Zhi — explicit files nobody maintains die together with the capability.
modern_applications_zh: 关键决策双源验证：财务与安全类决策强制两条独立信息链，单源不批
组织知识管理：把老师傅的默会经验写成参数化SOP（什么信号/什么阈值/怎么校准），防止'人走艺失'
数据产品质量：推算值定期与真实观测对账，偏差超阈即冻结流程先修模型
项目节奏管理：把外部周期（市场季节/政策窗口）编入计划，而非与环境对抗
modern_applications_en: Dual-source verification for critical decisions: finance and safety decisions require two independent information chains; single-source is not approved.
Organizational knowledge management: write master craftsmen's tacit experience into parameterized SOPs (signal / threshold / calibration), preventing 'people leave, craft leaves.'
Data-product quality: reconcile estimates against fresh observations on a schedule; freeze and fix when deviation exceeds threshold.
Pacing management: encode external cycles (market seasons, policy windows) into the plan instead of fighting the environment.
representative_figures: 郑和（核心）
马欢（通事与记录者）
王景弘（副使，航海业务共同主持）
哥伦布（同时代天文导航的另一路径）
modes.key_quote_zh: 仰观星斗定南北，俯察针路知东西；孤证不立，三说互证而后行。
modes.key_quote_en: Read the stars for latitude, the compass for bearing; a single witness never stands — sail only on the agreement of three.

modes.name_en: Display Without Conquest: Force as a Diplomatic Instrument
modes.definition_zh: 郑和的地缘政治命题：拥有压倒性武力而克制使用，'耀兵异域'与'不侵占'构成一体两面——武力是谈判桌的底牌而非第一选择。方法论签名有四：其一，比例响应分级——招抚→警告→有限军事行动三级递进，七下西洋28年仅三次较大战斗（旧港、锡兰山、苏门答腊），且均由对方先动手触发；其二，胜利的处置学——俘锡兰国王亚烈苦奈儿不杀不并，送回南京由皇帝赦免放归；俘陈祖义献俘正法但只诛首恶——用处置方式向各国传递'顺者安、逆者惩、无吞并'的可预期规则；其三，差序准入——以朝贡礼仪给各国分层待遇，用仪式秩序替代殖民秩序；其四，公共品供给——剿海盗（陈祖义集团）护航马六甲海峡，提供的安全是区域公共品而非占领。与利德尔·哈特'间接路线'与'限战节制'（M-LH-001/M-LH-004）同构：最高战略是让武力停留在'不必使用'的位置上。
modes.definition_en: Zheng He's geopolitical proposition: hold overwhelming force yet restrain its use — 'displaying arms abroad' and 'conquering nothing' are two faces of one doctrine: force is the hidden card at the table, never the opening move. Four signatures. First, graduated proportional response: pacification, warning, limited action in three steps; across 28 years and seven voyages only three sizable battles (Old Port, Ceylon, Samudera), all triggered by the other side striking first. Second, the handling of victory: captured King Alaungpaya of Ceylon — seized after his 50,000 besieged the fleet — was neither killed nor dispossessed but pardoned and returned; pirate chief Chen Zuyi was executed yet only the ringleaders — the manner of handling transmits a predictable rule to all states: comply and rest, resist and be punished, none annexed. Third, hierarchical access: tiered treatment under tribute ritual, replacing colonial order with ritual order. Fourth, public-goods supply: destroying Chen Zuyi's pirate fleet made the Strait of Malacca safer for everyone — security as a regional public good, not occupation. Isomorphic with Liddell Hart's indirect approach and limitation of war (M-LH-001, M-LH-004): the highest strategy keeps force parked at 'never needing to be used.'
modes.source_chapter: 《明史·郑和传》；《明成祖实录》永乐五年、九年、十三年条；《皇明祖训》'不征之国'条；万明《郑和七下印度洋》
process_zh: 建立武力使用三级门槛：招抚/警告/行动逐级授权，行动必须由对方越线触发并留下完整记录
设计胜利后的处置方案先于战斗本身：俘虏、赔偿、赦免的每种结局都是向第三方广播的规则
以秩序供给替代领土占有：给合作方分层礼遇与贸易准入，让'进入秩序'比'被占领'更有吸引力
识别并清除公共敌人：打击海盗式破坏者，让区域所有参与者受益，把安全变成盟友网络的粘合剂
process_en: Build a three-threshold authorization ladder for force: pacify / warn / act; action only on the other side's crossing, with a complete record.
Design post-victory handling before the battle: each outcome — capture, reparations, pardon — broadcasts a rule to third parties.
Supply order instead of seizing territory: tiered courtesy and trade access make 'joining the order' more attractive than being occupied.
Identify and clear public enemies: strike pirate-style spoilers so every regional participant benefits — security becomes the glue of the alliance network.
representative_cases_zh: 旧港之战（1407）：剿灭陈祖义海盗集团后设立旧港宣慰司，以侨领施进卿为宣慰使——不驻军不殖民，用地方自治机构承接安全红利，此后海峡航路'海道由是而清宁'
锡兰山之战（1410-1411）：亚烈苦奈儿发兵五万围攻船队，郑和率二千精锐乘虚破城生擒国王——回朝后成祖赦免放归，锡兰此后与明维持朝贡关系；武力克制反而扩大了规则的可信度
反面警示：爪哇西王误杀明军170余人，成祖仅令赔金六万两且未足额追缴——'宽纵'与'克制'的界限模糊时，威慑信号随之衰减；克制若无一致的惩罚底线，会被解读为可欺
representative_cases_en: The Old Port battle (1407): after destroying Chen Zuyi's fleet the Ming established the Old Port Pacification Commission under the expatriate leader Shi Jinqing — garrisoned by no one, the safety dividend was carried by local self-rule; the strait 'became clear and at peace.'

The Ceylon war (1410-11): King Alagakkonara sent 50,000 to besiege the fleet; Zheng He with 2,000 elites struck the empty capital and captured the king — the emperor pardoned and returned him, and Ceylon kept tribute relations with the Ming; restraint made the rule more credible.

Cautionary counterexample: when West Java's men killed 170 Ming soldiers by mistake, the emperor demanded a mere 60,000 taels of gold — never fully paid; where restraint and leniency blur, deterrence decays — without a consistent floor of punishment, restraint reads as exploitability.
modern_applications_zh: 武力使用门槛设计：安全与执法行动设三级授权与'对方先动手'触发条款，避免先发制人的声誉成本
平台治理：对破坏者精准执法（诛首恶）而对普通参与者宽容，处置结果公开成为社区规则
大国外交：以秩序与公共品（护航、基建、标准）替代领土式扩张，让加入体系比对抗更有利
竞争克制的一致性：克制须配惩罚底线，宽纵个案会削弱整个规则体系的可信度
modern_applications_en: Threshold design for force: security and enforcement actions carry a three-level ladder and an 'opponent moves first' trigger, avoiding the reputational cost of preemption.
Platform governance: precise enforcement against spoilers, leniency toward ordinary participants; publish outcomes as community rules.
Great-power diplomacy: offer order and public goods (escort, infrastructure, standards) instead of territorial expansion — joining beats resisting.
Consistency of restraint: restraint needs a punishment floor; leniency toward single cases corrodes the credibility of the whole rule system.
representative_figures: 郑和（核心）
朱棣（'不征之国'框架的制定者）
施进卿（旧港自治承接者）
利德尔·哈特（间接路线的同构理论家）
modes.key_quote_zh: 耀兵异域者，示可用兵也；不征者，示不必用兵也。威之所在，乃兵之所不用处。
modes.key_quote_en: To display arms is to show one can fight; not to conquer is to show one need not. True might lies where the sword stays sheathed.

modes.name_en: The Treasure-Fleet Marketplace: State Trade as Portfolio Design
modes.definition_zh: 郑和的贸易命题：把商业舰队设计成'移动的多品类货架+官方市场'，以朝贡-回赐为框架做国家间贸易。方法论签名有四：其一，品类组合管理——船上载金银、瓷器、丝绸、茶叶、铜钱、农具，按各国需求差异化配置，是'投资组合'而非单一货物押注；其二，等价物切换——在无统一货币的印度洋贸易圈里，以实物（丝绸瓷器）与金银在各地切换结算媒介；其三，官方定价与市场询价并用——各国'勘合'贸易凭证制度控制准入，同时接受当地行商的市价谈判；其四，逆周期采购——在产地收购香料、染料、珍宝，回程在需求地销售，赚的是信息与通道的差价。同时须记录其结构性弱点：朝贡贸易'厚往薄来'，回赐价值常高于贡品，贸易按政治逻辑而非盈亏逻辑运转——这是该模式必须警示的失衡点。
modes.definition_en: Zheng He's trade proposition: design the fleet as a mobile, multi-category marketplace under a tribute-and-bestowal framework of interstate trade. Four signatures. First, portfolio management of cargo: bullion, porcelain, silk, tea, copper cash and farm tools aboard, differentiated by each port's demand — a portfolio, not a single-cargo bet. Second, switching the medium of settlement: across the currency-fragmented Indian Ocean trading circle, settlement shifts between goods (silk, porcelain) and precious metal by locale. Third, official pricing coexisting with market bargaining: the tally (勘合) system gates access while local brokers negotiate market prices. Fourth, counter-seasonal sourcing: buy spices, dyes and gems at origin, sell at demand centers on the return leg — earning the spread of information and of the corridor itself. The structural weakness must be recorded: tribute trade was 'generous out, meager in' — bestowals often exceeded the tribute's worth, and trade ran on political rather than P&L logic; this is the mode's mandatory warning.
modes.source_chapter: 马欢《瀛涯胜览》（各国贸易品目与交易方式）；费信《星槎胜览》；《明成祖实录》朝贡赏赐条；巩珍《西洋番国志》
process_zh: 按目标市场差异化配置'货架'：出发前逐港研究需求清单，配置对应品类与备选结算物
设计准入与定价双轨：官方渠道定信誉与准入（凭证/勘合），市场渠道做价格发现（行商谈判）
在产地与需求地之间做逆周期搬运：赚信息差与通道差，而不是赚单点暴利
为每笔贸易设定盈亏审计：政治性让利须有明确预算与上限，防止'厚往薄来'变成无底洞
process_en: Configure the 'shelves' per target market: before departure, study each port's demand list and load categories and settlement alternatives accordingly.
Run a dual track of access and pricing: official channels set credibility and entry (tallies), market channels do price discovery (broker bargaining).
Move goods counter-seasonally between origin and demand centers: earn the spreads of information and of the corridor, not single-point windfalls.
Impose a P&L audit on every transaction: political concession must carry an explicit budget cap, lest 'generous out, meager in' become a bottomless pit.
representative_cases_zh: 满剌加（马六甲）据点：设官厂（仓库基地）作为分船队集散地——货物在此分装转运，是15世纪的'区域枢纽仓'，通道价值高于单笔交易价值
古里（卡利卡特）大宗交易：以丝绸瓷器换香料宝石，由当地行商居间议价，官方见证击掌成交——官方信用与市场议价的并行结构
反面警示：'厚往薄来'的财政失衡——各国'朝贡'动机实为套利（回赐常高于贡品数倍），贡使越频繁财政出血越大，成为远航停罢的经济内因之一；政治逻辑压倒盈亏逻辑的贸易设计不可持续
representative_cases_en: Malacca as a node: official depots (guanchang) served as staging bases for the divided squadrons — cargo sorted and transshipped there, a fifteenth-century 'regional hub warehouse' whose corridor value outweighed any single trade.
Bulk trade at Calicut: silk and porcelain exchanged for spices and gems, local brokers mediating, officials witnessing the clap-of-hands deal — official credit and market bargaining in parallel.

Cautionary counterexample: the fiscal imbalance of 'generous out, meager in' — states 'paid tribute' to arbitrage (bestowals often several times the tribute's worth), and the more frequent the missions the deeper the bleeding; one of the economic internal causes of the voyages' halt — trade designed on political logic over P&L logic is unsustainable.
modern_applications_zh: 出海业务货架设计：按目标国差异化产品组合，附备选结算方案（本币/易货/第三方货币）
平台准入双轨制：凭证准入保信誉，市场层自由议价保流动性
逆周期采购策略：在供给过剩地买入、需求紧缺地卖出，赚通道与信息差
战略业务盈亏审计：政治性投入单列预算上限，定期审计防止无限补贴
modern_applications_en: Shelf design for going abroad: differentiated product portfolios per target country, with fallback settlement options (local currency / barter / third currency).
Dual-track platform access: credentialed entry for credibility, free bargaining at market layer for liquidity.
Counter-seasonal sourcing: buy where supply glutters, sell where demand pinches — earn corridor and information spreads.
P&L audit for strategic business: political outlays get their own budget cap and periodic audits to prevent open-ended subsidy.
representative_figures: 郑和（核心）
马欢（贸易过程的亲历记录者）
施进卿（旧港贸易与自治的结合点）
王景弘（船队后勤与物资管理）
modes.key_quote_zh: 载天下之货，行天下之市；不以一港之利，废万国之通。
modes.key_quote_en: Carry the goods of all under heaven to the markets of all under heaven; never sacrifice the trade of ten thousand states for one port's profit.

modes.name_en: The Interpreter-Intelligence Network: Knowledge Before Sailing
modes.definition_zh: 郑和的信息命题：远洋决策的质量取决于抵达前的知识存量。方法论签名有四：其一，通事层级——船队建制通事（翻译）与火长（领航），并沿途吸收会阿拉伯语、泰米尔语、波斯语的当地人才，使语言能力随航线一起增长；其二，文本情报回路——费信《星槎胜览》、马欢《瀛涯胜览》、巩珍《西洋番国志》三部亲历记录，把各国风土、航路、政治形势写成国家记忆；其三，先行节点情报——每一航段的据点（满剌加官厂、旧港宣慰司）同时是情报节点，先遣使节与滞留商人提供前方动态；其四，回程复训——每一次出航都是对上次记录的现场校勘，'知识-行动-修订'的循环在28年间运转七轮。这与孙武'知彼知己'（M-SW-003）同构，且把'知'从战前侦查扩展为跨代际的组织学习。
modes.definition_en: Zheng He's information proposition: the quality of blue-water decisions is set by the knowledge stock accumulated before arrival. Four signatures. First, an interpreter hierarchy: the fleet carried institutional interpreters (tongshi) and navigators (huozhang), absorbing local speakers of Arabic, Tamil and Persian along the way — language capability grew together with the routes. Second, a documentary intelligence loop: Fei Xin's Xingcha Shenglan, Ma Huan's Yingya Shenglan and Gong Zhen's Xiyang Fanguo Zhi — three eyewitness records turning foreign lands, routes and politics into national memory. Third, forward-node intelligence: each staging point (the Malacca depots, the Old Port commission) doubled as an intelligence node; advance envoys and resident merchants fed back conditions ahead. Fourth, return-leg retraining: every voyage field-checked the previous voyage's records — the knowledge-action-revision cycle ran seven rounds across 28 years. Isomorphic with Sunzi's 'know the other, know yourself' (M-SW-003), extended from pre-battle reconnaissance to cross-generational organizational learning.
modes.source_chapter: 马欢《瀛涯胜览》自序；费信《星槎胜览》；巩珍《西洋番国志》；《郑和航海图》地名考释
process_zh: 把语言与情报岗位写进建制：出航编制含通事/领航/记录官，并按航段增补本地语言人才
要求亲历者写报告：每一次外派产出结构化文本（风土/航路/政治/价格），归档为组织记忆
在关键节点设常驻情报前哨：据点同时承担补给与信息功能，先遣与滞留人员构成预警网
建立'下航校上航'的循环：每次行动出发前必读上次记录，抵达后逐项核对修订
process_en: Institutionalize language and intelligence posts: rosters include interpreters, navigators and record-keepers, with local-language talent added by leg.
Require field reports from participants: every deployment produces structured text (land, routes, politics, prices), archived as organizational memory.
Station intelligence outposts at key nodes: footholds serve both supply and information; advance envoys and resident merchants form the early-warning net.
Run a 'next voyage audits the last' loop: before departure read the previous record; on arrival verify and revise item by item.
representative_cases_zh: 马欢作为通事随行四次，回国后写成《瀛涯胜览》——该书成为今日重建郑和船队各国见闻的第一史料，证明'随行记录'是比战利品更持久的产出
满剌加官厂：分船队在此等候季风集结，同时汇总各方向航路动态——补给节点与情报节点的合一设计
反面警示：远航停罢后三部亲历文献一度散佚难寻，《郑和航海图》靠《武备志》偶然收录才存世——组织记忆若只存在于少数文献与个人记忆中，制度停转即记忆断绝
representative_cases_en: Ma Huan, an interpreter on four voyages, wrote the Yingya Shenglan at home — today the primary source for reconstructing the fleet's observations, proof that 'records made en route' outlast trophies.
The Malacca depots: divided squadrons assembled there awaiting the monsoon while pooling route intelligence from all directions — supply node and intelligence node as one design.

Cautionary counterexample: after the voyages halted the three eyewitness books were nearly lost, and the charts survived only by chance inclusion in the Wubei Zhi — when organizational memory lives in a few documents and a few heads, stopping the machine amputates the memory.
modern_applications_zh: 外派人员情报职责：外派编制含记录官岗位，产出结构化报告并归档为组织资产
国际化人才梯队：按目标市场逐段吸收本地语言与合规人才，语言能力与业务版图同步扩张
区域枢纽双重职能：海外据点同时承担物流与市场情报，先遣团队构成预警网
迭代校勘机制：每次行动前必读上次复盘，抵达后逐项核对，知识库七轮迭代胜过一次性调研
modern_applications_en: Intelligence duties for deployed staff: rosters include record-keepers producing structured reports archived as organizational assets.
International talent pipeline: absorb local-language and compliance talent leg by leg, growing language capability with the business map.
Dual-function regional hubs: overseas footholds carry both logistics and market intelligence; advance teams form the early-warning net.
Iterative field-auditing: read the last debrief before each operation, verify on arrival — seven iterations of a knowledge base beat one-off research.

马欢（通事/《瀛涯胜览》）
费信（随行记录者/《星槎胜览》）
巩珍（随行记录者/《西洋番国志》）
modes.key_quote_zh: 未至其国，先知其俗；不一其闻，必三其证。
modes.key_quote_en: Know a land's customs before reaching it; never trust one hearing — seek three attestations.

modes.name_en: Divided-Squadron Coordination: Orchestrating Without Real-Time Communication
modes.definition_zh: 在无无线电的时代指挥两百余艘船、27000人的船队，郑和的解法是'分合有序'的编队学：以宝船为核心、马船与战船分层护卫的战斗编组，平时集中航行、到港后分船队分头行动（分赴古里、忽鲁谟斯、满剌加等支线），以天文钟点、针路与物标为'共同协议'约定再集结的时间与地点。方法论签名有四：其一，母港-支线拓扑——以满剌加官厂为区域集结枢纽，分船队由此辐射，结构上等同于今天的 hub-and-spoke；其二，协议式集结——'某季风窗口、某锚地再会'的事前约定替代实时通信，协同建立在共享参数（季风、针路、更数）之上；其三，分层授权——郑和总揽外交与战略，航海业务由王景弘等副使分担，各分船队有独立的指挥序列；其四，冲突升级回路——分船队遇战斗自行处置，但俘获国王一级的处置必须回到主队与朝廷决策（锡兰山之战的善后即由成祖裁定）。这是分布式组织的古典原型：带宽为零时，靠共享模型而非共享信道达成协同。
modes.definition_en: Commanding over two hundred ships and 27,000 men with no radio, Zheng He's solution was a choreography of 'divide and reassemble': a battle formation layering treasure ships, horse ships and warships; sailing concentrated en route but splitting into detached squadrons in port (to Calicut, Hormuz, Malacca), with reassembly fixed in advance by shared parameters — monsoon windows, needle-routes, watch-counts and landmarks. Four signatures. First, hub-and-spoke topology: the Malacca depots as the regional rendezvous, squadrons radiating from it — structurally the modern hub-and-spoke. Second, protocol-based reassembly: pre-agreed 'same monsoon window, same anchorage' replaces real-time communication; coordination rests on shared models (monsoon, compass route, distance-in-watches), not shared bandwidth. Third, layered delegation: Zheng He held diplomacy and strategy; Wang Jinghong and deputy envoys carried navigation business; each detached squadron had its own command chain. Fourth, an escalation loop: squadrons handled local combat autonomously, but king-level outcomes (as at Ceylon) returned to the flagship and the throne for decision. A classical prototype of the distributed organization: at zero bandwidth, coordinate through shared models, not shared channels.
modes.source_chapter: 《明史·郑和传》（分船队与使者分遣记载）；《郑和航海图》（满剌加官厂与分针路标注）；马欢《瀛涯胜览》
process_zh: 把'何时何地再会'写成事前协议：分散行动前固定再集结的时间窗、锚地与失联应急规则
设区域枢纽承担分合：中枢节点管集散、仓储与信息汇总，支线单元由此辐射
分层授权并设升级线：一线单元自决日常处置，涉及全局后果的事项回中枢裁决
以共享参数替代实时通信：全员对齐节律（季风/针路/更数），协同建立在共同模型上
process_en: Write 'when and where we reassemble' as a protocol: fix the reassembly window, anchorage and lost-contact contingency before any split.
Use a regional hub for division and reassembly: the central node handles transshipment, storage and information pooling; branch units radiate from it.
Delegate in layers with an escalation line: frontline units decide routine matters; anything with system-level consequences returns to the center.
Substitute shared parameters for real-time comms: align everyone on rhythm (monsoon / compass route / watches); coordination rides on a common model.
representative_cases_zh: 满剌加官厂：分船队在此'打整番货'、等候季风集中回航——《瀛涯胜览》明载其仓储与集结功能，是印度洋季风节律下的'协议式集结'枢纽
分遣使节与分船队：第四次下西洋分船队分赴忽鲁谟斯、阿丹等地，主队与分队的再会以季风窗口为约——多线并行而不失建制
反面警示：协同依赖季风节律意味着刚性时间表——分船队一旦错过窗口即滞留一年以上，随行人员长驻他国（部分通事水手因此定居南洋）；协议式协同对'错过协议'缺乏恢复机制，是它的固有脆弱性
representative_cases_en: The Malacca depots: detached squadrons 'sorted the foreign cargo' there and waited for the monsoon to reassemble — the Yingya Shenglan explicitly records the storage and rendezvous function, a protocol-hub built on the Indian Ocean monsoon rhythm.
Detached envoys and squadrons: on the fourth voyage squadrons fanned out to Hormuz, Aden and beyond, reassembly set by the monsoon window — parallel lines without losing the formation.

Cautionary counterexample: coordination hostage to the monsoon meant a rigid timetable — miss the window and a squadron waited a year or more (some interpreters and sailors settled abroad); protocol coordination lacks a recovery mechanism for 'missing the protocol' — its inherent fragility.
modern_applications_zh: 分布式团队协议：跨时区团队以'共享节律+固定再同步点'替代全员实时在线，失败时预设回滚锚点
多线作战的项目管理：区域枢纽承担集散与信息汇总，各工作流独立推进、按窗口合并
授权升级矩阵：一线自决清单+必须上报清单写成协议，避免既越权又失职
零带宽环境预案：通信中断时按预共享参数行动（时间窗/集结点/默认策略）
modern_applications_en: Distributed team protocols: cross-timezone teams run on shared rhythm plus fixed re-sync points, with rollback anchors when sync fails.
Multi-track program management: a regional hub pools transshipment and information; workstreams advance independently and merge by window.
Delegation-escalation matrix: a written protocol of 'decide locally' vs 'must escalate' lists, avoiding both overreach and abdication.
Zero-bandwidth contingency: when comms drop, act on pre-shared parameters (time window / rendezvous point / default posture).
representative_figures: 郑和（核心）
王景弘（副使，分担航海指挥）
朱棣（朝廷一级的最终裁决者）
洪保（分船队副使）
modes.key_quote_zh: 分舟各行其路，合舟同赴其期；不以言语相闻，而以节律相守。
modes.key_quote_en: The divided fleets sail their several roads; the assembled fleets keep one appointed season. They hear no voices — they keep the rhythm.

modes.name_en: The Eunuch-Admiral's Leverage: Turning Marginal Identity into Cross-Boundary Capital
modes.definition_zh: 郑和是穆斯林宦官统率以儒家官僚为主的国家舰队——三重边缘身份（非汉人出身、宦官、无科举功名）恰恰构成他的执行优势：其一，对皇帝的单线忠诚——宦官无后无党，被视为不威胁文官集团的行动者，朱棣因此敢把帝国最庞大的武力交给他；其二，跨文明接口——云南穆斯林家庭出身（其父与祖父有朝觐之称），熟悉伊斯兰世界与海洋贸易族群网络，正是印度洋外交最需要的接口能力；其三，绕开官僚轨道——宦官系统直属皇帝，不受六部与都察院的常规制衡，出航决策与执行周期远短于文官程序；其四，宗教灵活性——船队沿途在天妃宫祭妈祖、在锡兰布施佛寺（永乐七年布施锡兰山佛寺碑以汉文/泰米尔文/波斯文三体铭刻）、在爪哇马来世界尊重伊斯兰社群——一队三祭，身份不设单一边界。方法论签名：把组织不信任的位置变成组织需要的接口——边缘性即杠杆。该模式同时警示其代价：身份优势完全依附于皇帝个人的信任，宣德后新朝廷转向海禁，边缘身份立刻从杠杆变为负资产——郑和终于第七次航行的归途（一说卒于古里）。
modes.definition_en: Zheng He — a Muslim eunuch commanding a state fleet staffed by Confucian-bred officers — turned a triple-marginal identity (foreign birth, eunuch status, no examination degree) into executive advantage. First, single-line loyalty to the emperor: eunuchs left no heirs and built no faction, seen as actors who would not threaten the civil bureaucracy — which is why the Yongle Emperor dared hand him the empire's largest armed force. Second, a cross-civilizational interface: born to a Muslim family in Yunnan (his father and grandfather had made the pilgrimage), versed in the Islamic world and in maritime trading networks — precisely the interface the Indian Ocean diplomacy required. Third, bypassing the bureaucratic track: the eunuch establishment answered to the emperor directly, outside the routine checks of the Six Ministries and the Censorate; voyage decisions and execution cycles ran far shorter than civil procedures. Fourth, religious flexibility: en route the fleet honored Mazu at Tianfei temples, endowed Buddhist shrines in Ceylon (the 1409 trilingual stele — Chinese, Tamil, Persian), and respected Muslim communities in the Javanese-Malay world — one fleet, three rites, identity bounded by no single confession. The mode also warns of the cost: the identity advantage hung entirely on one emperor's personal trust; after Xuande, when the court turned to sea bans, marginal identity flipped from leverage to liability — Zheng He died on the return leg of the seventh voyage (by one account, at Calicut).
modes.source_chapter: 《明史·宦官传·郑和》；永乐七年《布施锡兰山佛寺碑》（三体文字碑）；袁忠彻《古今识鉴》；李至刚撰马哈只墓碑铭
process_zh: 识别'边缘身份'的杠杆面：无派系、可越轨制、跨文化能力，把组织不愿用的人用在组织够不着的地方
为跨界任务配置跨界接口人：语言、宗教、商业网络能力优先于科层资历
为高度依附性设保险：把个人能力写进制度与文本（如三体碑、亲历记录），降低对单一庇护人的依赖
审计身份杠杆的翻转风险：庇护人更替时，边缘身份可能瞬间从资产变负债
process_en: Identify the leverage face of 'marginal identity': no faction, able to bypass routine checks, cross-cultural competence — use people the organization distrusts for places the organization cannot reach.
Assign cross-boundary interface people to cross-boundary missions: language, religion and network competence outrank hierarchical seniority.
Insure against dependency: write personal capability into institutions and texts (trilingual steles, eyewitness records) to reduce reliance on a single patron.
Audit the flip-risk of identity leverage: when the patron changes, marginal identity can turn from asset to liability overnight.
representative_cases_zh: 永乐七年（1409）布施锡兰山佛寺碑：汉文、泰米尔文、波斯文三体铭刻，分别施予佛寺、印度教神庙与当地伊斯兰社群——一块碑同时向三种文明出示身份与敬意，是'跨文明接口'的实物证据
郑和出身云南昆阳穆斯林家庭，父马哈只曾赴天方朝觐（李至刚撰墓碑铭为证）——任命他出使印度洋伊斯兰贸易圈，是把个人出身变成国家接口的决定
反面警示：宣德八年远航结束后，新朝廷转向海禁，郑和的宦官身份在文官笔下的记载被系统性贬低（《明史》对其多贬语），大量档案散佚——依附单一庇护人的身份杠杆，庇护人离场即被清算
representative_cases_en: The 1409 trilingual stele at Ceylon: inscribed in Chinese, Tamil and Persian, endowing Buddhist, Hindu and local Islamic institutions at once — one stone showing identity and respect to three civilizations, material evidence of the cross-civilizational interface.

Born to a Muslim family of Kunyang, Yunnan — his father, the 'Hajji Ma,' had made the pilgrimage (per Li Zhigang's epitaph) — appointing him to the Indian Ocean Islamic trading circle turned personal origin into a national interface.

Cautionary counterexample: after the voyages ended the new court turned to sea bans, the civil historians systematically belittled the eunuch admiral (the Ming History carries slurs), and many archives scattered — identity leverage resting on a single patron is settled accounts the day the patron leaves.
modern_applications_zh: 非常规人才使用：高信任缺口任务交给'无派系利益'的边缘人才，配套任期与问责设计
跨文化商务代表：派驻人员优先匹配当地语言与宗教文化能力，而非仅按总部资历排序
关键人员依赖审计：核心能力若系于单一庇护人或单一关系链，须文档化与制度化对冲
多认同管理：面向多文化市场时，身份表达保持多接口（多语言、多礼节），不设单一边界
modern_applications_en: Unconventional talent deployment: give high-trust-gap missions to faction-free marginal talent, with term and accountability design attached.
Cross-cultural business representatives: staff postings by local language and religious-cultural competence, not headquarters seniority.
Key-person dependency audit: when core capability hangs on one patron or one relationship chain, hedge with documentation and institutionalization.
Multi-identity management: in multi-cultural markets keep identity multi-interfaced (languages, courtesies), never single-bounded.
representative_figures: 郑和（核心）
朱棣（边缘身份的识别与启用者）
马欢（穆斯林通事的接口能力实例）
侯显（同为出使西洋的宦官使者）
modes.key_quote_zh: 身在朝列之外，故能行朝列所不能行；寄信任于一主者，慎其终。
modes.key_quote_en: Standing outside the ranks, he did what the ranks could not; who rests his trust on one patron must mind the ending.

modes.name_en: Ritual Order over Territorial Order: Hierarchy Without Occupation
modes.definition_zh: 郑和船队输出的不是领土而是秩序：以朝贡-册封礼仪构建一套'谁在什么位置'的差序结构，各国以名义臣属换取贸易准入与安全庇护，明朝以册封文书与赏赐换取'万邦来朝'的合法性叙事。方法论签名有四：其一，名实交换——对方得实利（贸易、护航、册封的合法性），明朝得名分（朝贡记录、礼仪位置），双方各取所需而无需一兵一卒常驻；其二，仪式即治理——迎诏、开读、赏赐、筵宴的每一步礼仪都是主权等级的可视化宣示，用剧场性替代行政性；其三，准入分层——按'向化'程度给予勘合、贡期、路线的差别待遇，秩序的内部有激励梯度；其四，低成本的秩序记账——不设总督不驻军队，秩序的维持成本被压缩到使团接待与文书往来。这一模式的边界也须记录：名分秩序在对方实力变化或明朝海禁转向时迅速失效——满剌加被葡萄牙人攻灭（1511）时，这套秩序没有任何救援机制；仪式性忠诚扛不住炮舰。
modes.definition_en: What the treasure fleet exported was not territory but order: a tribute-and-investiture hierarchy fixing 'who stands where' — states exchanged nominal subordination for trade access and security, while the Ming exchanged documents and bestowals for the legitimacy narrative of 'all under heaven coming to court.' Four signatures. First, name-for-substance exchange: the other side gains real benefit (trade, escort, the legitimacy of investiture), the Ming gains rank-records and ritual position — each takes what it needs with not one garrison ashore. Second, ritual as governance: receiving the edict, public reading, bestowal, banquet — every step visualizes the sovereignty hierarchy, replacing administration with theater. Third, tiered access: tallies, tribute schedules and routes granted by degree of 'orientation toward civilization,' an incentive gradient inside the order. Fourth, low-cost order accounting: no governors, no garrisons — the cost of maintaining order compressed to hosting missions and exchanging documents. The mode's boundary must also be recorded: the nominal order failed fast when the other side's power shifted or the Ming turned inward — when the Portuguese took Malacca (1511), this order had no rescue mechanism; ritual loyalty could not withstand gunpowder.
modes.source_chapter: 《明史·外国传》满明史·外国传》满剌加/苏禄/浡泥各条；《明会典》朝贡通例；万明《明代外交模式研究》；《瀛涯胜览》各国礼仪记载
process_zh: 设计名实交换结构：明确各方以什么名义换什么实利，使合作无需常驻强制即可自我维持
把等级写成可见的仪式：接待、授证、排序的每个环节都传递位置信息，让剧场承担治理
建立准入激励梯度：按合作深度给予差别化的准入、周期与礼遇，秩序内部留上升通道
审计秩序的维持成本与救援能力：名分若无可信的武力与资源背书，秩序在压力测试下不设防
process_en: Design a name-for-substance exchange: define what each side trades in name for in substance, so cooperation self-sustains without standing coercion.
Make hierarchy visible as ritual: every step of reception, certification and seating transmits position information — let theater do governance.
Build an incentive gradient of access: differentiated entry, schedules and courtesies by depth of cooperation, keeping an upward path inside the order.
Audit the order's maintenance cost and rescue capacity: a nominal order without credible force and resources behind it stands undefended under stress tests.
representative_cases_zh: 苏禄国东王亲自率使团朝贡（1417），病逝于德州归途，永乐帝以王礼葬之并遣使抚其国——仪式级盟友关系的顶格样本，'以礼葬之'的象征投入远低于驻军成本
满剌加拜里米苏拉两次亲赴南京朝贡，获封国王并求铭其山为'镇国之山'——小国以名分换安全承诺，明朝以文书换航路枢纽
反面警示：正德六年（1511）葡萄牙人攻陷满剌加，流亡王室向明求援，明朝除诏书谴责外无任何实际行动——仪式秩序无救援机制，在炮舰时代迅速证明其防御力为零；名分若无可信武力背书，只是记账符号
representative_cases_en: The east king of Sulu led his mission to court in person (1417) and died at Dezhou on the way home; the emperor buried him with royal rites and consoled his state — the top sample of ritual-grade alliance, where a symbolic burial cost far less than a garrison.

Parameswara of Malacca twice journeyed to Nanjing, was invested as king, and asked that his mountain be inscribed a 'mountain of the protected state' — a small state trading name for a security promise, the Ming trading documents for a route hub.

Cautionary counterexample: when the Portuguese stormed Malacca in 1511, the exiled royal house appealed to the Ming, which answered with nothing beyond a reproachful edict — a ritual order with no rescue mechanism proved to have zero defense in the age of gunpowder; name without credible force is only an accounting symbol.
modern_applications_zh: 生态位治理：以认证与排序机制（而非接管）组织生态伙伴，名分与流量互换来维持秩序
仪式性投入的ROI核算：象征性投入（接待、授牌、公开背书）优先于常驻成本，但须审计其威慑力边界
分层准入设计：按合作深度差别化权益，为伙伴留升级通道以固化秩序参与
秩序的压力测试：定期评估'若伙伴遇袭我方救援机制是否真实存在'，名分承诺必须配套可信资源
modern_applications_en: Niche governance: organize ecosystem partners through certification and ranking rather than takeover, trading name for flow to sustain the order.
ROI accounting for ritual investment: symbolic spending (reception, credentials, public endorsement) before standing costs — but audit the deterrence boundary.
Tiered access design: differentiated rights by cooperation depth, with an upgrade path to cement participation in the order.
Stress-testing the order: regularly assess 'if a partner is attacked, does our rescue mechanism actually exist' — nominal promises must carry credible resources.

朱棣（秩序框架的最终定义者）
拜里米苏拉（满剌加，以名分换安全的合作方样本）
东王巴都葛叭哈剌（苏禄，亲朝的顶格样本）
modes.key_quote_zh: 不置一吏于其境，而万国知其所居；礼之所在，即序之所在。
modes.key_quote_en: Not one official placed on their soil, yet all states know where they stand; where the rite stands, there stands the order.

modes.name_en: Working the Monsoon Window: Strategy Timed to Natural Rhythms
modes.definition_zh: 印度洋季风半年一换：冬东北风送船西去，夏西南风送船东归——郑和的全部日程都长在季风节律上：候风出洋、按季集结、错峰分遣。方法论签名有四：其一，把外部节律变成战略日历——不是对抗自然而是把自然周期直接写进行动计划，出航、集结、回航各有其'风'；其二，窗口内最大化——季风窗口内运输效率最高，分船队在此期间并行作业，窗口关闭前回到锚地；其三，以等待为成本结构的一部分——滞留候风不是浪费而是计划内成本，船队在满剌加'住候'数月是标准动作；其四，节律错配的识别——何时该等待、何时风险大于等待（政治窗口关闭、敌方先动），是节律策略的判断核心。与'兵贵神速'（M-SW-008）互补而非矛盾：神速指窗口内的执行速度，节律指窗口本身的把握——在自然节律面前，'快'服从于'当'。
modes.definition_en: The Indian Ocean monsoon reverses twice a year: winter's northeast winds carry ships west, summer's southwest winds carry them home — every line of Zheng He's schedule grew on this rhythm: depart with the wind, assemble by season, dispatch off-peak. Four signatures. First, turn the external rhythm into the strategic calendar: not fighting nature but writing natural periodicity directly into the plan — departure, assembly and return each have their 'wind.' Second, maximize inside the window: transport efficiency peaks within the monsoon window; detached squadrons work in parallel during it and return to anchorage before it closes. Third, waiting as part of the cost structure: lying at anchor for the wind is not waste but planned cost — 'dwelling and waiting' at Malacca for months was standard practice. Fourth, recognizing rhythm mismatch: when to wait, and when risk outruns waiting (political windows closing, the enemy moving first) — the judgment core of rhythm strategy. Complementary, not contradictory, to 'speed is precious in war' (M-SW-008): speed governs execution inside the window, rhythm governs the window itself — before natural rhythm, 'fast' submits to 'timely.'
modes.source_chapter: 《瀛涯胜览》'住候'记载；《郑和航海图》航线与季风配合研究；万明《郑和七下印度洋》
process_zh: 识别行动所依赖的外部节律（市场/政策/自然），把节律直接写进行动日历
在窗口内最大化并行：窗口期集中投放资源，窗口关闭前完成回收与集结
把等待列为计划内成本：为'候风'式滞留预留预算与心理预期，不把等待记为失败
设定节律错配的判断规则：列出'不再等待'的触发条件，防止在失效窗口内硬闯
process_en: Identify the external rhythm the action depends on (market / policy / natural) and write it directly into the action calendar.
Maximize parallelism inside the window: concentrate resources during it; complete recovery and reassembly before it closes.
Book waiting as planned cost: budget and set expectations for 'waiting for the wind' — waiting is not failure.
Set rules for rhythm mismatch: list the triggers for 'stop waiting,' preventing forcing a failed window.
representative_cases_zh: 七次出航的往返窗口全部与季风吻合：冬季趁东北风南下西行，夏季趁西南风北上东归——28年无一次逆季风硬闯的记录，是'把自然写进计划'的极限案例
满剌加'住候'：分船队在官厂数月等候季风转换、集中回航——等待被制度化为流程环节而非事故
反面警示：第七次下西洋（1431-1433）时郑和已年逾六旬，船队仍按季风节律完成全程，但郑和本人病逝于归途——节律策略保证的是行动成功率而非个人寿命；窗口策略无法对冲执行者的时间成本
representative_cases_en: Every round trip of the seven voyages matched the monsoon: south and west on winter's northeast winds, north and home on summer's southwest winds — 28 years without a single record of forcing against the monsoon, a limiting case of 'writing nature into the plan.'
Dwelling at Malacca: detached squadrons waited months at the depots for the monsoon to turn and reassemble — waiting institutionalized as a process step, not an accident.

Cautionary counterexample: on the seventh voyage (1431-33) Zheng He, past sixty, still completed the full circuit on monsoon time — but died on the return leg; rhythm strategy guarantees the action's success rate, not the executor's lifespan; window strategy cannot hedge the executor's own time cost.
modern_applications_zh: 市场节奏管理：把行业周期（采购季/预算季/政策窗口）写进产品与销售日历，窗口内并行冲刺
候机式投入：为'等待时点'预留预算与编制，把观望列为计划内动作而非组织内耗
窗口关闭的触发规则：事先列明放弃等待的条件（竞品先动/政策转向），避免在死窗口内硬闯
执行者时间成本审计：长期窗口策略须评估关键人的健康与任期，节奏不能只算事不算人
modern_applications_en: Market-rhythm management: write industry cycles (procurement season / budget season / policy windows) into product and sales calendars; sprint in parallel inside windows.
Standby investment: budget and staff for 'waiting for the window'; list watching as a planned action, not organizational friction.
Trigger rules for closed windows: pre-list conditions for abandoning the wait (competitor moves first / policy turns), avoiding forcing a dead window.
Executor time-cost audit: long-horizon window strategy must weigh key people's health and tenure — the rhythm counts persons, not only plans.

modes.key_quote_en: The wind keeps faith; the sail keeps season. Contend not with the wind — sail with it.

modes.name_en: The Archive-Discontinuity Audit: Reading What the Silence Tells
modes.definition_zh: 郑和档案的遭遇本身是一个思维模式：远航停罢后官方文书系统性散佚（刘大夏藏匿/焚毁航行档案的著名公案），《明史》对郑和记载简略且含贬语，今日对宝船尺度、航行动机、死亡地点的认知都建立在残缺与相互矛盾的史料上——这教会我们用'档案的断层'本身作为证据。方法论签名有四：其一，沉默检测——'应该有记录却没有'本身就是信号：一场28年、累计27万余人次的国家级行动只留下极少量官方文本，说明制度性销毁或忽视发生过；其二，多源比对——以马欢、费信、巩珍三部亲历文献与官方实录互校，亲历者记录与官方叙事的分歧处（如旧港之战的性质）恰是叙事政治的显影处；其三，实体证据兜底——南京静海寺残碑、长乐《天妃灵应之记》碑、锡兰三体碑等实物铭刻替代散佚文书，成为可独立检核的时间锚；其四，叙事利益分析——追问'谁需要这个版本的叙事'：焚毁档案的兵部（节省论）、贬低宦官的文官（党争论）、近代救亡叙事（民族英雄论）各自生产了不同的郑和。这是司马迁'实录精神'（M-SMQ-321）的反向运用：当实录缺席，从缺席中读史。
modes.definition_en: The fate of Zheng He's archives is itself a mode of thinking: after the voyages halted, official documents were systematically scattered (the famous case of Liu Daxiao hiding or burning the voyage files), the Ming History records him briefly and with slurs, and what we know of ship dimensions, voyage motives and even his death rests on fragmentary, mutually contradictory sources — teaching us to read the rupture in the archive as evidence. Four signatures. First, silence detection: 'records that should exist but don't' is itself a signal — a 28-year state operation moving over 270,000 person-trips leaving almost no official text indicates institutional destruction or disregard. Second, multi-source comparison: checking the three eyewitness books (Ma Huan, Fei Xin, Gong Zhen) against the official veritable records — where eyewitness and official narratives diverge (as on the nature of the Old Port battle) is precisely where narrative politics develops. Third, physical evidence as the floor: the Jinghai Temple fragment, the Tianfei steles at Nanjing and Changle, the trilingual stele in Ceylon — inscribed objects replace lost documents as independently checkable time anchors. Fourth, interest analysis of narrative: ask 'who needs this version' — the Ministry of War that burned files (economy), the civil officials who belittled eunuchs (faction), the modern salvation narrative (national hero) each produced a different Zheng He. The reverse application of Sima Qian's spirit of faithful record (M-SMQ-321): when the faithful record is absent, read history from the absence.
modes.source_chapter: 《明史·郑和传》；《殊域周咨录》所记刘大夏焚档公案；长乐《天妃灵应之记》碑（宣德六年，1431）；南京静海寺残碑；马欢/费信/巩珍三部亲历文献与《明实录》互校
process_zh: 对重大行动做'应有记录清单'：列出本应存在的文书类别，逐项检测其缺失并推断缺失方式（失传/销毁/未产生）
以亲历文本与官方叙事互校：分歧点标注为叙事政治高发区，双读并存
用实物证据建立时间锚：碑刻、器物、建筑与文书互证，防止单一文本系谱垄断历史
对流传叙事做利益方分析：每个版本的'郑和'背后是谁在需要这个版本，证据等级随利益距离递减
process_en: For major operations maintain a 'records that should exist' list: itemize the document classes, test each for absence, and infer the mode of absence (lost / destroyed / never produced).
Cross-check eyewitness texts against official narrative: mark divergence points as high-risk zones of narrative politics, and read both side by side.
Use physical evidence as time anchors: steles, artifacts and buildings corroborate documents, preventing a single textual lineage from monopolizing history.
Run interest analysis on transmitted narratives: behind every version of the story stands someone who needs it; evidentiary weight decays with proximity to interest.
representative_cases_zh: 长乐《天妃灵应之记》碑（宣德六年，1431）：郑和第七次出航前亲自立碑，历叙七下西洋经过——因太平港天妃宫的宗教属性躲过官方档案清洗，成为今日最可靠的自我陈述原始文献；'档案被销毁处，碑刻替文书发言'
旧港之战的叙事分歧：《明实录》记陈祖义'诈降潜谋邀劫'，马欢《瀛涯胜览》仅记其'凶横'而无劫船之谋——亲历通事与官方叙事的分歧提示'师出有名'的建构可能，是叙事政治显影的标本
反面警示（模式自身的适用边界）：实体证据同样可被污染——静海寺残碑文字漫漶导致宝船尺寸争议百年未决，'碑刻时间锚'也有信噪比，须与文本证据互相校验而非单独采信
representative_cases_en: The Tianfei 'Record of Miraculous Response' stele at Changle (1431): Zheng He erected it in person before the seventh voyage, recounting all seven expeditions — spared by the religious status of the Tianfei temple when official archives were purged, it is today the most reliable self-statement; where files were destroyed, the stone speaks for the documents.

The narrative divergence over the Old Port battle: the Ming Veritable Records have Chen Zuyi 'feigning surrender to plot plunder,' while Ma Huan's eyewitness book records only his 'violence' with no ship-plundering plot — the divergence between interpreter and state narrative flags the possible construction of a casus belli, a specimen of narrative politics developing.

The mode's own applicability boundary as caution: physical evidence can also be contaminated — the weathered Jinghai Temple fragment has fueled a century-long dispute over treasure-ship dimensions; even 'stele anchors' carry signal-to-noise and must be checked against texts, not trusted alone.
modern_applications_zh: 组织档案连续性审计：对核心业务做'应有记录清单'与缺失归因，沉默期列为风险信号
历史舆情复盘：官方通报与亲历者记录分歧处即叙事政治区，双读并存防止单线叙事固化
关键节点物理存证：重大决策以多方签署、多介质存档（含脱网介质），防系统性清洗
叙事利益审计：传播中的每个版本先问'谁受益'，证据采信度随利益距离递减
modern_applications_en: Archive-continuity audits: maintain 'records that should exist' lists for core business, attribute the gaps, and treat silence periods as risk signals.
Historical sentiment review: where official communiques diverge from participants' records lies narrative politics — read both to keep a single line from ossifying.
Physical attestation at key nodes: major decisions signed by multiple parties and archived on multiple media (including offline), against systematic purges.
Narrative-interest audits: for every circulating version ask 'who benefits'; evidentiary weight decays with distance from interest.
